initialization: fresh matched random weights; no pretrained reference
environment: fixed [.1,.9] square, no per-net bbox rescaling
transport: direct average L1 between correspondingly labeled pins; no assignment minimization
radius: a priori fixed .04; no quantile or reference optimization
model_selection: minimum validation worst-group mean own-action length; earliest ties
references: none: no optimal labels, MST, geometric bound, Hungarian, external pretrained weights or solver
pure_rl_mainline: erm_critic,erm_rollout,wdro_rl; remaining adversaries are diagnostic controls
acceptance_scope: degree30 from-scratch proof of concept; no exact regret or optimality claim

statistics.primary: own-action length mean/P95/worst group; matched before/after and methods; candidate budget and actual time
